subskills.label: Define project-scope boundaries
subskills.capability_statement: Given a bounded improvement scenario and stated project intent, distinguish in-scope from out-of-scope work and identify boundary assumptions or interfaces that still require sponsor or business confirmation.

subskills.label: Select project metrics
subskills.capability_statement: Given a bounded project objective and candidate measures, identify metrics that meaningfully observe the stated project objective and distinguish supported measures from assumptions that still require evidence.

subskills.label: Select a project-planning tool for a bounded need
subskills.capability_statement: Given a stated project-planning need, select an appropriate planning-tool class and explain what information or decision the tool is intended to support without treating a tool choice as evidence of project success.

subskills.label: Maintain coherent project documentation
subskills.capability_statement: Given bounded project records, identify missing, inconsistent, or stale documentation needed to preserve traceability of project decisions, evidence, scope, and status without fabricating unobserved approvals or outcomes.

subskills.label: Analyze and manage project risk
subskills.capability_statement: Given a bounded project scenario, identify material project risks, distinguish supported risk evidence from assumptions, and describe a proportionate mitigation or monitoring response without claiming the risk has been eliminated.

decomposition_edges.rationale: Make project-scope reasoning independently assessable while preserving sponsor and business boundary decisions as unresolved when they are not present in evidence.
Represent metric selection as an assessable project capability without converting a provisional owner-derived interpretation into source-authored measurement semantics.
Make project-planning-tool selection independently assessable without asserting a proprietary or source-explicit tool sequence absent from the frozen node evidence.
Expose project-documentation integrity as a bounded assessable capability while retaining approval, authorship, and observed project outcomes as external evidence boundaries.
Make project-risk reasoning assessable while distinguishing analysis and response planning from unobserved real-world risk outcomes.

unresolved_dependency_candidates.reason: A project charter may define or constrain project scope, but the frozen source title and locator do not by themselves establish a mandatory hard-prerequisite edge.
Project scope may condition which project metrics are appropriate, but stronger semantic or SME evidence is required before admitting a hard dependency.
Scope can influence planning-tool use, but the frozen source identity does not establish a required dependency direction.
Project planning and risk management are plausibly related capabilities, but source adjacency is insufficient to canonically admit a prerequisite.
